evidence.title: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work

summary: Apodex 1.1, the latest version of the AI platform, expands its agentic capabilities to autonomously handle multi‑step, complex work across a range of industries. The update adds larger memory buffers, advanced planning modules, and tighter integration tools designed to boost enterprise productivity.
title: Apodex 1.1 Launches to Scale Agentic Intelligence for Complex Tasks
